Field guide

Land somewhere new. Meet who lives there.

Eight worlds each have their own critter. The first time any of your ships touches down on one, you discover it. After that, a little group comes out to say hi every time you land there.

How it works

Land, discover, collect

  1. Touch down

    Land or splash down on Mun, Minmus, Duna, Ike, Eve, Laythe, Tylo or Moho. Probes count too.

  2. Discover it

    Your first landing there pops up New creature discovered! with its picture and a fun fact.

  3. Open the Book

    Click the paw button on the toolbar. Found critters show in color. The rest are dark shadows.

  4. Meet the herd

    Land on that world again and a little group roams near your lander or your Kerbal on EVA.

Out in the field

Cute vs wild

Cute · 5 of them
5 m

Crater Hopper, Mint Slider, Dust Puff, Glow Drifter and one more secret critter come right up close. Three of them roam together.

Wild · 3 of them
18 m

The three wild ones are still classified. They are bigger and shy, and keep their distance, in pairs.

Going home
3 km

Fly or drive more than 3 km away, or leave the world, and the herd heads home. Land again to see them.

New part · VAB, Science tab

The Critter Crate

A small orange crate (0.08 t) with a paw print on the side. Put it on any ship to show off a critter you have found.

Right-click the crate

Next critterPick the next critter you have found

Open crateA spinning cyan hologram floats above the lid. Click again to close.
Release critterA real critter hops out next to your landed ship.Sandbox

Sandbox also adds Spawn near me, Unlock all (test) and Lock all again to the Creature Book. In Science and Career you find them the real way.

Troubleshooting

Something not right?

I landed but nothing popped up

Only the 8 worlds above have critters for now. If you landed before installing the mod, switch to that landed ship and it counts after about 2 seconds.

I don't see any critters roaming

They only come out near the ship you are flying, when it is landed on a world whose critter you have found. Wild ones stay about 18 m away, so look around.

The crate only shows one critter

The crate can only show critters you have discovered. Go find more!

There's no Release button on the crate

Release only shows in Sandbox games, in flight, when the ship is landed.

Where is the paw button?

On the stock toolbar in the Space Center, the VAB and in flight. It opens the Creature Book.

How do I remove the mod?

Take Critter Crates off your ships first, then delete GameData/KerbalCritters.
